brand_signal: Champion paddler who coaches: water force, athletic discipline, Lviv aquapark gym. Ukrainian voice. Signature is a paddle-strike through the IG mark into ocean video — not a club slogan.
composition: Editorial current: full-bleed video hero, overlapping display type on a waterline, horizontal stat lane, manifesto rows, three vertical story films, results-board pricing. Not a SaaS card grid.
typography: Unbounded for display (Cyrillic, athletic, not Bebas/Barlow default). Manrope for body. One accent word in azure.
color: Abyss #03090d, navy #07141c, azure #2ad4e8, aqua #7ef0d4, foam #e8f7f3, mist #9ec9c4, gold #c9a45c only on the intro mark. No orange. No red-black gym cliche.
motion_intent: One orchestrated intro (logo spring, paddle slash, clip-path split). Scroll reveals via transform/opacity. Videos pause offscreen. prefers-reduced-motion skips intro.
do_not: Invent fake client testimonials or before/after bodies
Generic 01/02/03 gym cards unless the content is a real sequence

rules: Azure as the only loud accent

layout_system.summary: Max ~1180px wrap, full-bleed media exceptions, 4-col stats collapsing to 1.

imagery_rules.summary: Prefer real trainer media. Hero must be ocean kayak. Coaching clip proves live training.
rules: No stock gym cliche as primary

responsive.summary: Desktop cinematic columns collapse to stacked films and a hamburger nav.

motion.summary: Intro is the signature. Elsewhere restraint.

cta_hierarchy.summary: Primary: free consultation. Secondary: method. Pricing rows point to the same form.

a11y_ux.summary: Skip link, focus rings, 44px targets, reduced motion. Not a conformance claim.
